selected_evidence.summary: Shows the enabled/active service, persistent configuration, 127.0.0.53 UDP/TCP listener, application resolver path, and observed cache hit.
External archlinux.org lookups succeed, with global and DHCP-provided upstream DNS servers present before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fe6e58b2-7e4d-4e8a-b1d7-3a15564059bb; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 611cec02-4b59-4696-b0b8-172d79a6e549; service, configuration, listener, external resolution, and caching recovered.
